rule: Existing loop admits only a full512-byte nonzero header; existing A01 unsigned checksum, A02 octal size grammar and A03 <=32MiB/body extent execute before the branch. No checks moved or replaced.

Only decoded primitive name exactly package AND decoded type exactly5 take new branch. Existing name construction remains unchanged. Exact literal has no slash, backslash, traversal segment or colon; prefix is explicitly empty. No casefolding/slash stripping/path normalization.
Root length must be numeric zero as parsed by existing octal check. Nonzero sizes are rejected, not clamped or skipped. No body byte is consumed as directory payload.

Root branch requires existing field decoder to observe ustar in257..263 and version00 in263..265. Unknown/legacy/GNU/PAX formats are not newly admitted by this exception. No guarantee all legal tar formats supported.

Root branch also requires whole inflated tar length divisible by512, rejecting a partial terminalblock in any archive taking this branch. Existing completeblock loop and checksum apply to following entries. This is a root-route restriction, not a general ordinary-parser rewrite.

After validation offset advances exactly512 then continues; zero payload means same stride as normal zero-size directory. No repeatedheader/infinite loop; offset monotonic and inflated tar cap bounds maximum headers. No filesystem entry is created, hashed, counted or inserted for root.

All nonroot entries run byte-identical A04-A09 and shared stride. package/ remains on old path; ./package, lookalikes, links, PAX x/g, GNU L/K and unknown types get no new exception. Root followed by ordinary badpath/type/duplicate retains exact existing rejection.

A09 files.size>0 remains: root-only/repeatedroots/zero blocks cannot satisfy content acceptance. Root metadata neither rewrites files map nor bypasses subsequent pinned dependency bytes/inventory/metadata/resolution checks.

Existing first-zero-block/EOF and NUL-field interpretation remains; no complete tar conformance, trailing-content authenticity or global ordinary-directory validation claim. Root archives with incomplete total blocks now reject; nonroot-only inherited trailingfragment behavior is unchanged.

New assert uses fixed message invalid exact package root directory. It lies before A04, so original A04 wrappers are bypassed only for eligible rootdir; failure has existing outercatch/samevalue rethrow and may retain generic tar-parse or stale marker. No new enum/record/relay change. It is functional acceptance change and requires separate review/controls.
